Multiple claims affirm America's leadership position and its commitment to working with allies to promote freedom and confront global challenges. Claims also suggest that US strength abroad contributes to safety at home.
label.title: US Global Leadership and International Relations

claims.claim_text: The United States is strongest when its partners are strong.
The United States today spends more on its armed forces than does the rest of the world combined.
In an American century, America will have the strongest economy and the strongest military in the world.
Through collective effort, Americans can overcome challenges.
The United States shares its deepest values with democracies.
Affirmation of America's role in leading the world toward greater freedom, opportunity, and prosperity.
America represents a set of ideals that speak to the highest aspirations of humanity.
America is preserving the peace by working with more than 80 allied nations and international institutions to isolate and confront terrorists and outlaw regimes.
Support for ensuring America remains competitive in the global marketplace.
The United States supports closer cooperation in both military and economic matters with those on the front lines of civilization's battle against the forces of evil.
America is stronger abroad and safer at home because of this principled leadership.
